column1: # C27 (b): the byte price of keeping colour, measured 2026-08-26 by Tools/score-mrc.swift.
# Three arms over ONE page set, one binary, `MRC_PAGES` per document:
#   ship-*        no MRC_COLOUR  — what the app publishes today
# `wantC` is `Flattener.shouldKeepColour`'s own answer for the page, so the arm that AGREES
# with it is a no-op and its row must reproduce the ship-* row exactly: it does on 30 of 30.

# requested in 20 documents; 30 have rows. The three without are `2013 - Silicon Valley
# Program Transcript` p13/p26 and `HarpersMagazine-1938-05-0019577` p4, which are 1-bit today:
# a page off the picture route has no colour decision to price, which is C27 (c).
